episodes.name: The End & the Beginning
episodes.overview: Superman is in a brutal battle with Luthor's monster; Lois and the boys race to save General Lane.

episodes.name: A World Without
episodes.overview: Lana and Sarah join the fight against Luthor; Jordan and Jonathan butt heads over a decision.

episodes.name: Always My Hero
episodes.overview: Reeling from failure, Jordan begins to spiral; Jonathan discovers newfound strength.

episodes.name: A Perfectly Good Wedding
episodes.overview: Lois helps throw Kyle and Chrissy an impromptu wedding that doesn't quite go as planned.

episodes.name: Break the Cycle
episodes.overview: Lois takes bolder actions to stop Luthor; Jonathan juggles personal life and responsibilities; Clark discovers an unsettling truth.

episodes.name: When the Lights Come On
episodes.overview: Luthor plans to move LuthorCorp to Smallville, but finds opposition in Lana.

episodes.name: A Regular Guy
episodes.overview: After some concerning interactions in town, Clark is determined to protect the secret that he's Superman – a task complicated by Jonathan and Jordan.

episodes.name: Sharp Dressed Man
episodes.overview: Luthor challenges Lois to a live telecast debate, though not everything is as it seems; John Henry and Clark face a troubling possibility.

episodes.name: To Live and Die Again
episodes.overview: Lois struggles against the fallout of the debate. Clark uses Luthor's tactics against him, while Jonathan and Jordan prepare for an impending battle.

episodes.name: It Went By So Fast
episodes.overview: The Kents fight with everything they have as Luthor makes his final move on Smallville.
